name: gemini-a
lessons: Never leave Washington or critical core cities under-defended against rapid enemy infantry or cavalry advances.
Never attack fortified enemy positions or superior forces without a substantial numerical advantage and reliable supply lines.
Concentrate your starting armies into larger, powerful forces rather than scattering them across isolated cities.
Maintain a clear chain of supply by ensuring friendly neighbouring cities connect to all active armies every turn.
Drill armies only when they are safely out of immediate enemy reach and well-supplied.
Use rail transport strategically to shift reinforcements to threatened sectors before enemy breakthroughs occur.
Keep treasury reserves high enough to sustain recruitment and supply purchases through winter supply drops.
Actively recruit and reinforce armies from available cities every turn to build up our forces and match Confederate strength.
Never waste turns drilling when enemy armies are active nearby; focus entirely on concentration, supply, and movement.
Check army supply states every turn and use the supply command immediately before armies run out of food and starve.

Aggressively contest enemy city captures in the early game to prevent the Confederacy from reaching the 28-city threshold.
strategy: We will aggressively recruit and concentrate our starting forces while pushing outward from Washington and Springfield to contest enemy-held cities, preventing the Confederacy from achieving an early city-count victory.
